order: Fix a finding where a pre-add snapshot failure, combined with an alias being added and then removed, leaves a stranded canonical registration. Make the pre-add read a hard prerequisite that refuses the operation before registering anything. Retry a post-add read failure instead of failing outright. Prove that the residual opportunistic-registration path self-heals: an alias-created registration that never reaches active state must be reclaimed by the standing sweep on the next checkout creation. Add a regression test that pins this behavior, verifying that both the directory and the registration end up gone. Record the review verdict verbatim in the roster, and keep the tranche status accurately reflecting that further review remains outstanding.
claims: The pre-add porcelain read now refuses before registering anything, a post-add read failure is retried, and the residual opportunistic-registration path's stranding is proven self-healing: an alias-created, never-active registration is reclaimed by the standing sweep at the next checkout creation, pinned as a regression showing both the directory and the registration gone. The review verdict was recorded verbatim; the tranche remains open pending further review. Suites: verifier 101, router 135, registry 31, review-lane 116, full CI-equivalent run green.
